I don't know about you, but for me watching this too much caused some pain in the eyes, so don't watch it for too long okay? Especially with loud music, listen to something slow & soft and you'll get the most out of it im sure.

Otherwise this preset is just another "accident" while playing around with superscopes, the scopes are actually 3D spiral spheres which are zoomed really close for what you see right now. There's three scopes each of which are basicly the same, but the, shall i say, "base", is on a different axis on each of them. The rotation speeds are individual as well, one uses getspec with the range of 0-0.4, one uses getosc with full 0-1 range and the third uses the sum of these divided by two (getspec+getosc)/2. So for all this the music reactions should be at place ;) But like i said, it spins a tad too fast with loud music and you'll probably not notice the reactions so well.

All in all, i like it, but for some odd reason it's heavy on the eyes, or maybe im just tired and i need to go to bed, that might be the reason too why my eyes hurt :P
